questions.text: A company wants to grant a 3rd party application access to their AWS account without sharing long-term credentials. Which service or feature should they use?
questions.why: AWS STS enables the creation of temporary, limited-privilege credentials to access AWS resources, which is ideal for cross-account or 3rd party access without sharing permanent access keys.

questions.text: An application runs batch jobs that can be interrupted and resumed without issues. The jobs take several hours to complete. Which EC2 purchasing option provides the most cost-effective solution?
questions.why: Spot Instances can offer up to a 90% discount compared to On-Demand pricing. They are the most cost-efficient option for workloads that are resilient to failure and can be interrupted, such as batch processing.

questions.text: A company needs to store regulatory documents for 7 years. The documents are rarely accessed, but when they are needed for compliance audits, they must be retrieved within milliseconds. Which S3 storage class is most appropriate?
questions.why: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval offers millisecond retrieval for long-term storage of data accessed maybe once a quarter, making it cheaper than Standard-IA but faster than Flexible Retrieval.

questions.text: A gaming company needs a fully managed, in-memory data store with sub-millisecond latency to maintain a real-time multiplayer leaderboard. Which AWS service fits this requirement?
questions.why: ElastiCache is a managed Redis or Memcached in-memory database that provides high performance and sub-millisecond latency, perfect for read-intensive caching workloads like leaderboards.

questions.text: You are designing a microservices architecture and want to run a Docker container without provisioning or managing any underlying EC2 instances. Which compute option should you choose?

options.text: Amazon ECS with EC2 launch type

questions.why: Fargate is a serverless compute engine for containers. It allows you to run Docker containers on ECS or EKS without having to manage the underlying EC2 infrastructure.

questions.text: A development team wants to deploy their application code and infrastructure together using familiar programming languages like Python and TypeScript instead of writing JSON/YAML templates. Which AWS tool allows this?
questions.why: AWS CDK allows developers to define cloud infrastructure using familiar programming languages (like Python, Java, JS/TS). The code is then compiled down into CloudFormation templates.

questions.text: An application is deployed in multiple AWS regions. You need to route users to the region that provides the fastest response time for them. Which Route 53 routing policy should you use?
questions.why: Latency Routing Policy is specifically designed to route user traffic to the AWS region that provides the lowest network latency, optimizing the global user experience.

questions.text: A media processing pipeline uses multiple microservices. You need to decouple the video upload service from the encoding service to handle sudden spikes in traffic without losing requests. Which service should you use?
questions.why: SQS is a message queue service used to decouple application tiers. If traffic spikes, messages wait safely in the queue until the encoding consumer service can process them.

questions.text: You need to track and audit all API calls made within your AWS account to identify which IAM user deleted a specific critical S3 bucket. Which service provides this capability?
questions.why: AWS CloudTrail provides governance, compliance, and auditing by recording a history of events and API calls made within the AWS account via the Console, SDK, or CLI.

questions.text: Your EC2 instances in a private subnet need to download software updates from the internet, but they must not be reachable from the internet. What VPC component is required to enable this?
questions.why: A NAT Gateway (placed in a public subnet) allows instances in private subnets to initiate outbound IPv4 traffic to the internet while preventing inbound traffic initiated from the internet.

questions.text: A security team wants to automatically detect and alert on sensitive information, such as personally identifiable information (PII), stored in their Amazon S3 buckets. Which service should they enable?
questions.why: Amazon Macie is a fully managed data security and data privacy service that uses machine learning and pattern matching specifically to discover and protect sensitive data (like PII) in Amazon S3.

questions.text: A customer service center wants to build a conversational chatbot that uses Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Natural Language Understanding (NLU). Which AWS Machine Learning service should they use?
questions.why: Amazon Lex is the service used to build conversational bots (chatbots). It uses the same ASR and NLU technology that powers Alexa to recognize intent from text and speech.

questions.text: A large enterprise wants to enforce compliance by explicitly preventing developers in specific AWS accounts from launching Amazon EMR clusters, regardless of their IAM permissions. How can this be centrally enforced?

options.text: Service Control Policies (SCPs) in AWS Organizations

questions.why: SCPs are used within AWS Organizations to restrict account privileges. They apply to all users (including the root user) and can explicitly blacklist or whitelist AWS services for entire accounts or OUs.

questions.text: A company needs a scalable network file system that can be mounted concurrently by hundreds of Linux EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. Which storage service should they choose?

options.text: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

questions.why: Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) is a managed network file system (NFS) that can be mounted by hundreds of Linux EC2 instances simultaneously across multiple Availability Zones.

questions.text: According to the AWS Well-Architected Framework, which of the following is a design principle that falls under the Reliability pillar?
questions.why: Testing recovery procedures is a core design principle of the Reliability pillar. It encourages using automation to simulate different failures to ensure the system can recover seamlessly.

questions.text: A company wants to stop guessing capacity and automatically scale their web servers based on the actual load. Which cloud computing characteristic does this represent?
questions.why: Rapid elasticity and scalability allow you to automatically and quickly acquire and dispose of resources when needed, scaling out and in based on actual demand.

questions.text: Which AWS deployment model keeps some servers on-premises while extending some capabilities into the AWS Cloud?
questions.why: A Hybrid Cloud deployment model combines on-premises infrastructure with public cloud resources, allowing control over sensitive assets while leveraging cloud flexibility.
questions.concept: Private vs Public vs Hybrid Cloud

questions.text: A company is migrating a legacy application that requires a specific, complicated per-socket software license. Which EC2 purchasing option allows them to bring this license to AWS?
questions.why: Dedicated Hosts provide a physical server with EC2 capacity fully dedicated to your use, giving you visibility into sockets and cores, which is required for Bring Your Own License (BYOL) scenarios.

questions.text: Which EC2 instance type family is best suited for in-memory databases and distributed web scale cache stores?
questions.why: Memory Optimized instances deliver fast performance for workloads that process large datasets in memory, such as high-performance relational or in-memory databases.

questions.text: If an EC2 instance in a private subnet needs to access the internet to download patches without allowing inbound traffic from the internet, what must be configured?
questions.why: A NAT Gateway (or NAT Instance) placed in a public subnet allows instances in private subnets to connect to the internet while preventing the internet from initiating connections to those instances.

questions.text: Which VPC feature acts as a stateless firewall at the subnet level, where you must explicitly define both ALLOW and DENY rules?
questions.why: Network ACLs act as a stateless firewall for subnets. Because they are stateless, return traffic must be explicitly allowed, and you can create both ALLOW and DENY rules.

questions.text: Which service provides a highly available, scalable, fully managed file system that can be mounted by hundreds of Linux EC2 instances simultaneously?

options.text: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

questions.why: Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) is a managed network file system (NFS) that scales automatically and can be attached to hundreds of Linux EC2 instances across multiple AZs.

questions.text: A business wants to store database backups for 6 months. The data is rarely accessed but must be available immediately if a disaster occurs. Which S3 storage class is the most cost-effective choice?
questions.why: S3 Standard-IA is cost-optimized for data that is infrequently accessed but requires rapid, millisecond access when needed (unlike standard Glacier, which has retrieval delays).

questions.text: Which database service provides a fully managed, serverless, key-value NoSQL database with single-digit millisecond latency at any scale?
questions.why: DynamoDB is AWS's fully managed, highly available, key-value NoSQL database designed for massive scale and single-digit millisecond latency.

questions.text: A data analytics team wants to query data stored directly in Amazon S3 using standard SQL without provisioning any infrastructure. Which service should they use?
questions.why: Amazon Athena is an interactive, serverless query service that allows you to easily analyze data in Amazon S3 using standard SQL.

questions.text: An application consists of tightly coupled microservices. You want to decouple these services by introducing a highly scalable, fully managed message queue. Which service fits this requirement?
questions.why: Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) is a fully managed message queuing service used to decouple application components and process messages asynchronously.

questions.text: Which AWS service allows you to distribute incoming HTTP and HTTPS web traffic across multiple targets (like EC2 instances) in multiple Availability Zones?
questions.why: The Application Load Balancer (ALB) operates at Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) and routes traffic to targets within Amazon VPC based on the content of the request.

questions.text: You want to automate the creation of your AWS infrastructure using code written in JSON or YAML. Which service provides this Infrastructure as Code (IaC) capability?
questions.why: AWS CloudFormation allows you to define and provision AWS infrastructure predictably and repeatedly using declarative JSON or YAML templates.

questions.text: Which AWS security service uses Machine Learning to continuously analyze VPC Flow Logs, DNS Logs, and CloudTrail Events to detect malicious or unauthorized behavior?
questions.why: Amazon GuardDuty is an intelligent threat discovery service that uses machine learning and anomaly detection on CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and DNS logs to protect your AWS account.

questions.text: A developer needs to store and automatically rotate database credentials and API keys securely. Which AWS service should they use?
questions.why: AWS Secrets Manager is specifically designed to store, retrieve, and automatically rotate database credentials, API keys, and other secrets.

questions.text: Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, which of the following is the customer's responsibility?

options.text: Physical security of the data center
Patching the Amazon RDS operating system
Configuring AWS WAF rules and EC2 security groups

questions.why: Customers are responsible for 'Security IN the Cloud', which includes configuring firewalls (Security Groups, WAF), managing IAM, and encrypting customer data.

questions.text: A company requires a private, dedicated physical connection between their on-premises data center and AWS that does not travel over the public internet. What service provides this?
questions.why: AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated, private network connection from your premises to AWS, bypassing the public internet for increased security and consistent network performance.

questions.text: Which AWS machine learning service provides highly accurate, real-time personalized product recommendations based on user history, similar to Amazon.com?
questions.why: Amazon Personalize is a fully managed ML service that allows developers to easily build applications with real-time personalized recommendations.

questions.text: An organization wants to centrally manage billing and apply compliance policies (SCPs) across multiple AWS accounts. Which service should they use?
questions.why: AWS Organizations allows you to consolidate billing across multiple accounts and apply Service Control Policies (SCPs) to centrally manage permissions and compliance.

questions.text: Which tool provides automated recommendations to optimize costs, improve performance, increase security, and monitor service quotas based on AWS best practices?
questions.why: AWS Trusted Advisor acts as an automated cloud expert, analyzing your account to provide recommendations across Cost Optimization, Performance, Security, Fault Tolerance, and Service Limits.

questions.text: A company is migrating an application 'as-is' from their on-premises data center to AWS EC2 instances without making any architectural changes. Which migration strategy (7Rs) does this represent?
questions.why: Rehosting, also known as 'lift-and-shift', involves migrating applications to AWS without making any changes to the underlying architecture.

questions.text: Which AWS service should be used to protect a web application running on an ALB against common Layer 7 web exploits like SQL injection and Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)?
questions.why: AWS Web Application Firewall (WAF) helps protect web applications against common web exploits at Layer 7 by letting you define rules that filter HTTP/HTTPS traffic.

questions.text: According to the AWS Well-Architected Framework, 'democratizing advanced technologies' and 'using serverless architectures' are design principles for which pillar?
questions.why: Performance Efficiency focuses on using IT and computing resources efficiently. Democratizing advanced technologies (using managed services) and adopting serverless are key principles here.

questions.text: A company needs to analyze trillions of events per day from IoT devices and requires a fast, serverless time-series database. Which AWS service fits this need?
questions.why: Amazon Timestream is a fast, scalable, serverless time-series database optimized for IoT and operational applications to store and analyze trillions of events daily.

questions.text: Which AWS service allows developers to quickly build, test, and deploy applications without worrying about infrastructure management, acting as a Platform as a Service (PaaS)?
questions.why: AWS Elastic Beanstalk is a Platform as a Service (PaaS) that handles capacity provisioning, load balancing, scaling, and application health monitoring automatically so developers can just deploy code.

questions.text: Which AWS global infrastructure component is used to cache content closer to end-users to reduce latency?
questions.why: Edge Locations are endpoints for AWS CloudFront (the CDN service) used to cache content closer to users globally, reducing latency.

questions.text: Which AWS Support plan provides access to a designated Technical Account Manager (TAM)?
questions.why: Only the Enterprise Support plan provides access to a designated Technical Account Manager (TAM) to provide proactive guidance and best practices.

questions.text: A company wants to estimate the monthly cost of running a specific architecture on AWS before actually provisioning any resources. Which tool should they use?
questions.why: The AWS Pricing Calculator allows you to estimate the cost of AWS services and architectural solutions before you build them.

questions.text: A developer needs to execute a backend script in response to an image being uploaded to an S3 bucket. The script takes 3 seconds to run. Which compute service is the most cost-effective?
questions.why: AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service that runs code in response to events (like an S3 upload). You only pay for the exact compute time used (e.g., 3 seconds).

questions.text: Which storage option provides temporary, block-level storage physically attached to the host computer of an EC2 instance, where data is lost if the instance is stopped?
questions.why: EC2 Instance Store provides temporary (ephemeral) block storage that is physically attached to the host. If the instance stops or terminates, the data is permanently lost.

questions.text: A company needs to transport 80 Terabytes of data from their on-premises data center to AWS. Their internet connection is slow and it would take months to transfer. Which service should they use?
questions.why: AWS Snowball Edge is a physical data transport device used to move petabyte-scale data into and out of AWS securely and quickly when internet connections are insufficient.

questions.text: Which AWS service is used to create and manage cryptographic keys that secure your data across various AWS services?
questions.why: AWS KMS is a managed service that makes it easy to create and manage cryptographic keys and control their use across a wide range of AWS services.

questions.text: A security auditor needs to download AWS compliance reports, such as SOC and PCI-DSS certificates, to prove that the AWS infrastructure is compliant. Where can they find these?
questions.why: AWS Artifact is your go-to, central resource for compliance-related information. It provides on-demand access to AWS security and compliance reports.

questions.text: You need to run a relational database on AWS and want to ensure it remains available even if an entire Availability Zone goes down. What feature should you enable?
questions.why: RDS Multi-AZ deployments provide high availability and failover support by automatically provisioning and maintaining a synchronous standby replica in a different Availability Zone.

questions.text: Which AWS service provides user sign-up, sign-in, and access control for web and mobile applications?
questions.why: Amazon Cognito lets you add user sign-up, sign-in, and access control to your web and mobile apps quickly and easily (often providing federated access via Google, Facebook, etc.).

questions.text: An application needs to publish alert messages to multiple subscriber systems simultaneously, including sending emails to administrators. Which service allows this Pub/Sub messaging?
questions.why: Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) is a highly available, durable, secure, fully managed pub/sub messaging service that enables you to decouple microservices and send emails/SMS.

questions.text: A company wants to simplify their network architecture by connecting thousands of VPCs and their on-premises networks using a single central hub. Which service should they use?
questions.why: AWS Transit Gateway acts as a central cloud router (hub and spoke model) to connect your Amazon VPCs, on-premises data centers, and SD-WAN gateways.

questions.text: Which AWS service is specifically designed to analyze images and videos to detect objects, people, text, scenes, and activities?
questions.why: Amazon Rekognition makes it easy to add image and video analysis to your applications using proven, highly scalable deep learning technology.

questions.text: You want to automate the patching of operating systems across a fleet of 500 Amazon EC2 instances to ensure they meet security baselines. Which service helps achieve this?
questions.why: AWS Systems Manager (specifically Patch Manager) automates the process of patching managed instances with both security related and other types of updates.

questions.text: Which service tracks changes to the configuration of your AWS resources over time, allowing you to audit compliance and troubleshoot issues?
questions.why: AWS Config enables you to assess, audit, and evaluate the configurations of your AWS resources, keeping a historical record of configuration changes.

questions.text: A company is experiencing large DDoS attacks on their web application and wants advanced protection that includes financial protection against scaling charges caused by the attack. Which service should they subscribe to?
questions.why: AWS Shield Advanced provides expanded DDoS attack protection for web applications, access to the 24x7 DDoS Response Team (DRT), and cost protection against resource scaling spikes.

questions.text: A developer is building a microservices architecture and needs a tool to visually trace requests as they travel through the various services to identify performance bottlenecks. What tool should they use?
questions.why: AWS X-Ray helps developers analyze and debug distributed applications, such as those built using a microservices architecture, by tracing user requests.

questions.text: You want to define permissions in a JSON document and attach it to an IAM user to restrict what AWS services they can access. What is this JSON document called?
questions.why: An IAM Policy is a JSON document that defines the specific permissions (Allow/Deny actions on resources) which can be attached to IAM users, groups, or roles.

questions.text: Which service allows you to write, run, and debug code with just a browser, acting as a cloud-based Integrated Development Environment (IDE)?
questions.why: AWS Cloud9 is a cloud-based integrated development environment (IDE) that lets you write, run, and debug your code with just a browser.

questions.text: A gaming application has a global audience. The company wants to route users to the AWS Region that is geographically closest to them. Which Route 53 routing policy should they use?
questions.why: Geolocation routing lets you choose the resources that serve your traffic based on the geographic location of your users (e.g., routing all European users to the Frankfurt region).

questions.text: Which database service is a fully managed MongoDB-compatible document database?
questions.why: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) is a fast, scalable, highly available, and fully managed document database service that supports MongoDB workloads.

questions.text: A startup wants to quickly launch a simple WordPress website on a virtual private server with a fixed monthly price. Which service is best suited for this?
questions.why: Amazon Lightsail provides easy-to-use virtual private servers (VPS) with everything needed to jumpstart a project (like WordPress) at a predictable, low monthly price.

questions.text: You want to receive an email notification when your AWS bill is projected to exceed $1,000 this month. Which tool should you configure?
questions.why: AWS Budgets allows you to set custom cost and usage budgets and receive alerts (via email or SNS) when your costs exceed (or are forecasted to exceed) your budgeted amount.

questions.text: Which fully managed big data service makes it easy to run Apache Hadoop, Spark, and Presto frameworks to process vast amounts of data?
questions.why: Amazon EMR (Elastic MapReduce) is a cloud big data platform for processing vast amounts of data using open source tools such as Apache Spark, Apache Hive, Apache HBase, Apache Flink, Apache Hudi, and Presto.

questions.text: Which service acts as a serverless event bus that connects application data from your own apps, SaaS, and AWS services, allowing you to route events to targets?
questions.why: Amazon EventBridge is a serverless event bus that makes it easy to connect applications together using data from your own applications, integrated SaaS applications, and AWS services.

questions.text: A company wants to run some of their AWS infrastructure on-premises within their own physical data center to meet ultra-low latency requirements. Which service provides this capability?
questions.why: AWS Outposts brings native AWS services, infrastructure, and operating models to virtually any data center, co-location space, or on-premises facility.

questions.text: What is the primary benefit of deploying an Amazon RDS database with Read Replicas?
questions.why: Read Replicas allow you to scale out beyond the capacity constraints of a single DB instance for read-heavy database workloads by routing read queries to the replicas.

questions.text: You want to automate your software release process by creating a CI/CD workflow that builds, tests, and deploys your code every time there is a code change. Which service orchestrates this?
questions.why: AWS CodePipeline is a fully managed continuous delivery service (CI/CD orchestration) that helps you automate your release pipelines for fast and reliable application updates.

questions.text: How does AWS Global Accelerator improve the performance of your global applications?

options.text: By caching static content at Edge Locations
By routing traffic over the AWS global network infrastructure using static IP addresses
By automatically increasing the CPU of your EC2 instances
By compressing images before sending them to users

questions.why: AWS Global Accelerator uses the highly available and congestion-free AWS global network to route user traffic, providing two static Anycast IP addresses and improving latency and throughput.

questions.text: An application needs to continuously capture and stream massive volumes of clickstream data from a website to an Amazon S3 bucket in real-time. Which service is designed for this?
questions.why: Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose is the easiest way to reliably load streaming data into data lakes, data stores (like S3 or Redshift), and analytics services in near real-time.

questions.text: Which component allows an EC2 instance to assume temporary credentials securely instead of hardcoding access keys in the application source code?
questions.why: An IAM Role is an identity with permission policies that determine what the identity can and cannot do. EC2 instances can assume a role to obtain temporary credentials to securely access AWS services.

questions.text: Which database service allows you to migrate an existing on-premises PostgreSQL database to AWS with minimal downtime?
questions.why: AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) helps you migrate databases to AWS quickly and securely. The source database remains fully operational during the migration, minimizing downtime.

questions.text: Which AWS pricing model allows customers with predictable workloads to commit to a 1- or 3-year term in exchange for significant discounts compared to On-Demand pricing?
questions.why: Savings Plans (and Reserved Instances) offer lower prices than On-Demand pricing in exchange for a commitment to a specific amount of usage for a 1- or 3-year period.

questions.text: Which AWS networking service allows you to create a secure, private connection between your on-premises network and your Amazon VPC over the public internet?
questions.why: AWS Site-to-Site VPN creates a secure IPsec VPN connection between your corporate data center and your AWS VPC, encrypting traffic over the public internet.

questions.text: A developer needs to store unstructured data consisting of millions of high-resolution images. The storage must be highly durable and infinitely scalable. Which service is the best fit?
questions.why: Amazon S3 is an object storage service designed for storing and retrieving any amount of unstructured data (like images, videos, backups) with 99.999999999% (11 9s) of durability.

questions.text: Which AWS service enables you to build visual workflows to coordinate and orchestrate multiple AWS Lambda functions?
questions.why: AWS Step Functions is a serverless function orchestrator that makes it easy to sequence AWS Lambda functions and multiple AWS services into business-critical applications (using visual workflows).

questions.text: Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, which of the following is the responsibility of AWS?

options.text: Encrypting data at rest in Amazon S3
Physical security of AWS data centers
Patching the guest operating system on EC2 instances

questions.why: AWS is responsible for 'Security OF the Cloud,' which includes protecting the physical infrastructure, facilities, hardware, and the global network.

questions.text: Which service should you use to monitor the CPU utilization of your EC2 instances and trigger an alarm if it goes above 80%?
questions.why: Amazon CloudWatch collects monitoring and operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events. It can trigger alarms (like scaling actions or SNS notifications) based on thresholds like CPU utilization.

questions.text: A company wants to ensure that all newly created S3 buckets automatically have versioning and logging enabled. Which service allows them to define these rules and automatically check compliance?
questions.why: AWS Config rules allow you to define desired configurations (like enforcing S3 versioning) and continually evaluate your resources against those rules for compliance.

questions.text: Which AWS service is used as a managed graph database designed for highly connected datasets, like social networking feeds or fraud detection?
questions.why: Amazon Neptune is a fast, reliable, fully managed graph database service built for storing and navigating highly connected relationships (using property graphs or RDF).
